findings.quote: However, it is simply impossible to ignore the fact that at present, the risks of an unchecked and unregulated advance in artificial intelligence could greatly outweigh its potential benefits.
findings.rationale: Warns that unregulated AI risks may outweigh its benefits.

findings.quote: AI companies need to be licensed based on specific requirements, adherence to human values, transparency, and most importantly, safety.
findings.rationale: Calls for AI licensing after discussing loss of control, jobs and concentration of wealth.

findings.quote: At the same time, I take the call by leading AI executives for a voluntary pause in the development of their models very seriously, but only, I repeat, only as a temporary measure to buy time for a powerful regulatory authority to be set up.
findings.rationale: Supports a temporary AI development pause and a strong regulatory authority.
